intent.raw: Use invoke refine to test whether one canonical ExecutionGraph JSON is the best ACI authority decision.
intent.objective: Produce a reviewed non-executed definition, design and plan for the single canonical ExecutionGraph authority boundary without changing runtime code.
intent.operator_sentence: Voce acha que essa é a melhor decisão? Quer fazer um invoke refine?

route_menu.context_hint: The owner decision exists, but the exact schema and authority/operational boundary are unresolved.

items.label: Standard local refine
items.description: Run the canonical ten stages over local CONF v1, runtime and ledger evidence; use external research only if a named gap appears.

items.label: Compact inline review
items.description: Review the decision without producing the full definition/design/plan evidence chain.

technique_overlays.trigger: Refine requires a ten-stage auditable authoring and critique sequence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes a named prior output and returns a native receipt or explicit blocked reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: One canonical pre-execution authority must coexist with separate confirmation evidence and post-confirmation operational facts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Single-authority and runtime-boundary roles remain distinct until synthesis; unresolved authority ownership blocks a pass verdict.

technique_overlays.trigger: Several plausible internal boundaries can satisfy one user-confirmed JSON while differing on embedded versus runtime-derived facts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Alternatives are compared on authority integrity, user comprehension, determinism, runtime feasibility and CONF v1 migration; rejected alternatives and trade-offs are retained.

technique_overlays.trigger: CONF v1 hides the authority across pending sheet, capability resolution, DispatchSpec, turn graph, mappings and runtime-derived artifacts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: A concrete review-correct-verify example demonstrates field completeness, projection stability, material-change detection and the pre/post-confirmation boundary.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The schema decision has two load-bearing perspectives that benefit from independent challenge before synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Two read-only sibling roles reduce the risk that a convenient single-document design either fragments authority again or incorrectly absorbs post-confirmation evidence.
context: CONF v1 currently separates pending input, resolved capabilities, DispatchSpec, confirmed graph, mappings and authority envelope.
The owner requires one canonical pre-execution authority JSON and three views of the same digest.
Confirmation observations, receipts, attempts and results occur after the graph is proposed.

roles.purpose: Attack fields and claims that cannot exist before confirmation or should remain runtime-derived evidence.
roles.owns: Authority/evidence separation, persistence feasibility, migration and failure boundaries.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Required local sources cannot be read or bounded without importing unrelated repository context.

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: The target cannot be defined without reopening a fixed owner decision.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: Both roles agree on the pre-confirmation authority boundary or record a blocker-level owner question.
Every surviving objection cites a local contract or runtime surface.
stop_conditions: Authority ownership remains contradictory after one critique exchange.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: External research is indicated but has not received separate user confirmation.

steps.name: Distill coherent authority unit
convergence_criteria: Select the smallest candidate that preserves one user-confirmed JSON and a truthful pre/post-confirmation boundary.
Record rejected alternatives and recomposition obligations.
stop_conditions: No candidate preserves the fixed owner decisions without an authority contradiction.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine and Design
stop_conditions: The design introduces a second pre-execution authority document or hides execution-relevant values from the full graph.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: The toy graph yields stable topology, basic and full views tied to one digest.
Every material mutation requires reconfirmation and post-confirmation facts remain outside the graph.
stop_conditions: The toy graph exposes an unowned executable field or inconsistent projection.

steps.name: Distill repair and validation
stop_conditions: A blocker survives repair or the selected unit no longer recomposes into the owner decision.

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: The plan attempts runtime mutation before an accepted v2 spec, fixture and independent review.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Stage receipts or required artifacts are missing.
The result claims implementation or execution evidence not produced by this run.

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json passes the deterministic validator before runtime-backed work.
The operator explicitly approves the displayed strategy and read-only subagent roles.
Any external research identified by a named gap receives separate explicit approval.
Every selected runtime-backed stage has a native receipt or explicit blocked reason.
Every stage marked pass points to an existing artifact.
The run does not silently replace one canonical pre-execution authority or treat operational evidence as user-authored plan data.
The run produces a non-executed plan and does not modify feature specs, fixtures, migrations or runtime code.
Final synthesis cites stage evidence, retains residue and distinguishes proposed, specified, validated and implemented claims.

boundaries.contract: No runtime-backed stage or subagent starts before explicit strategy approval.
Each capability owns its native artifact; Refine indexes and synthesizes without redefining it.
Writes remain inside this refinement-run folder; target specs, fixtures, ledger and code are read-only.

authority.execution: parent native runtime after operator approval
authority.evidence: stage capability owners with Refine index

promotion_splits.rule: Refine output is proposal and plan evidence only; a separate approved authoring or task route owns any mutation.

promotion_guardrails: Do not mutate ACI specs, fixtures, ledger, migrations or runtime code during this run.
Do not treat a schema proposal as accepted, implemented or deployed.
Do not interpret strategy approval as external research approval or runtime execution authority.
Return any contradiction with fixed owner decisions to an explicit owner gate.
